_about: How the Takemikazuchi's Type-87 assault cannon (Project MIKHAIL equip/weapon/gun87_00) sits in the two files of
Ronin's Leadwall (the game calls the model titan_triple_threat).  Hand-authored; this file is the whole fit.
The gun is used as it is: one rigid copy at the body's scale.  It is not a shotgun and Ronin's hands were posed
for the Leadwall, so the support hand will not rest on it - this is here to be looked at in game, and is its own
pair of files in the mod so it can be left out (GUN_UNIT empty).
At the body's own scale the gun came out 82 units long and 6 thick and read as a toy in Ronin's hands (owner,
2026-11-15: 'the assault gun is waaay too small. Perhaps that's its normal size but for this game it doesn't work').
The reason is the hands: Ronin's are 1.6 times the size of the Takemikazuchi's own (the fit scales the hands up to
Ronin's hand bones), and a gun is judged against the hand that holds it.
rule 'in_proportion_to_the_gun_hand': body scale x the hand's enlargement, read from the fit - the gun is to Ronin's
hand what it is to the Takemikazuchi's.  Other rules: 'body_scale' (as the sword), or 'times_body_scale' with a 'value'.
Project MIKHAIL holds the gun at its 'equip' marker, the model's own origin, at the top of the grip under the
gun's body.  The Leadwall files have Ronin's gun hand at their origin, likewise at the top of the grip.
Leadwall: barrel along +Z (muzzle bone at z = 98.7), up +Y, the titan's left +X.
Type-87 as cleaned: barrels along -Z (36 mm muzzle marker at z = -3.64 m), thickness X, and the grip on the +Y side,
so -Y is up.  Checked against Project MIKHAIL's own artwork of the Takemikazuchi holding it: the hand is under
the gun, the box magazine stands on top, the short 120 mm barrel sits above the long 36 mm one.
So the gun is turned half a turn about its thickness axis, like the sword: (x, y, z) -> (x, -y, -z).
Rows are the Leadwall's X, Y, Z.
the build stops unless the long barrel's muzzle ends up ahead of the hand, the short barrel above the long one,
and the bulk of the gun above the hand
Two named points in each Leadwall file say where effects appear; they are moved onto the new gun (display only).
muzzle_flash: flash and tracers - onto the 36 mm muzzle marker.
shell: ejected cases - Project MIKHAIL has no marker for it; placed by hand on the gun's right side just behind
the root of the 36 mm barrel (metres in the cleaned gun's own frame).

mesh_bone._about: the bone that carries the gun body in each stock file

_about: The Leadwall's separate pieces (its magazine, an optic) are switched on and off by the game during reloads.
The Type-87 has no such separate pieces, so each becomes a speck on the bone that carried it.
For the reload seen from the cockpit (data/reload_map.json, GUN_RELOAD) the Type-87's box magazine is taken out of
the first-person file's gun mesh and becomes that file's magazine piece (the part the game hides and shows during
a reload), on its own bone.  Which pieces: every separate piece of the mesh that lies wholly inside this box,
in metres in the cleaned gun's own frame - the curved box and its end cap, not the collar on the gun it slots into
(checked in build/renders/retarget/gun_pieces.png).  The world model keeps the gun whole.
